why: Both proposals share the cognac leather armchair, the jute rug, the knit throw, the linen curtains and the dark wood pieces. A wins because its turned-wood lamp with a linen shade carries the warm, natural look the client asked for, while B's chrome swing-arm lamp feels cold and out of place. In both, the single 90 cm bookcase is too narrow to fill a good part of the left wall as requested, so a second unit should be added.
